verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe delivers events through webhooks and event destinations such as EventBridge. These are developer building blocks: the user must write the handler logic that turns an event into an action. There is no first-party rule engine for user-defined event-to-action automation. The only no-code event automation cited is Kyber, a third-party app in the Stripe Apps marketplace, not Stripe's own capability. Smart Retries is a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
